newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary overnight rates slip to 27.50pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary overnight rates slip to 27.50pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates eased 0.5 percent on Wednesday but remained high on the last day of the banks' two-week reserve period, dealers said.
Overnight rates moved to 27.50 percent compared with Tuesday's close of 28 percent.
"The rates will probably fall back to 'normal' levels on Thursday, the first day of the new reserve period," said Istvan Zsoter of Takarekbank.
Overnight rates usually hover around the benchmark one-week reverse repo rate of the central bank, currently at 21.75 percent.
